scripts.build: bun run --cwd web build && bun run --cwd packages/plugin-sdk build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd web typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/plugin-sdk typecheck
scripts.test: bun run --cwd web test && cd server && GOSUMDB=sum.golang.org GOTOOLCHAIN=auto go test ./...
scripts.server: cd server && GOSUMDB=sum.golang.org GOTOOLCHAIN=auto go run ./cmd/server
scripts.mcp: cd server && GOSUMDB=sum.golang.org GOTOOLCHAIN=auto go run ./cmd/mcp
scripts.pm2:build: bun run build:local && cd server && GOSUMDB=sum.golang.org GOTOOLCHAIN=auto go build -trimpath -o ./bin/openboard-server ./cmd/server
scripts.pm2:start: node --test scripts/pm2-env-core.test.mjs && pm2 startOrReload ecosystem.config.cjs --update-env && pm2 save
